title: Endeavour Silver | Endeavour Silver Restores Guanaceví Mill to Full Capacity Following Trunnion Replacement
summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. is a mid-tier precious metals mining company listed on the NYSE:EXK and TSX:EDR.
body_markdown:
**VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Endeavour Silver Corp.** **(“Endeavour” or the “Company”)** **(NYSE: EXK; TSX: EDR)** is pleased to announce that repairs to the primary ball mill trunnion at its Guanaceví mine have been successfully completed and the replacement trunnion has been installed.


Following the successful completion of repairs, processing at Guanaceví returned to full capacity (see the September 22 news release[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D_AarpJoYshYtvcbtIxk1Rbda4y8TRgSdpRHhIfWVWQenjdJQp5JPHoq5im1Ed5DizwQ-uziEWtHhaGw8oy4kXnj12iaZ7Pcjt_2JFYZc2FRw0VNXU6iAUkFRxjlAiHMpSieH_kaeRgwuBsjVmP47YyLd-3jCRqGGYbLhCMqMEY=) ).


**About Endeavour Silver** **–** Endeavour is a mid-tier silver producer with three operating mines in Mexico and Peru and a robust pipeline of exploration projects across Mexico, Chile, and the United States. With a proven track record of discovery, development, and responsible mining, Endeavour is driving organic growth and creating lasting value on its path to becoming a leading senior silver producer.
